title: AquaSense: monsoon forcing, depth-aware calibration and decision value in national-scale groundwater forecasting for India
description: Code, results, figures, dashboard and manuscript for a national-scale study of groundwater-level forecasting in India: the skill added by monsoon forcing, depth-aware conformal calibration and the economic value of exceedance warnings. Results, figures and text are CC BY 4.0; see LICENSES.md.
